title: To change our existing website into an Ecommerce platform
proj_desc:
We are looking for an experienced Wix developer to add full e-commerce functionality to our existing Rock Recycling website:

We are an aggregates and recycling business based in Andover, Hampshire, expanding our website to allow customers to purchase landscaping and aggregate products online.

This is not a new website build. We want to develop our existing Wix website into a professional e-commerce site while retaining the existing branding and overall structure.

Wix e-commerce/store setup
Online product catalogue
Shopping basket and secure checkout/payment
Product variations where required
Correct VAT configuration/display
Inventory/product availability management
Postcode-based delivery pricing
Collection option from our Andover yard
Mobile optimisation
Fast, intuitive customer journey
Analytics/conversion tracking
Appropriate accessibility
Simple back-end management for products, prices and orders
Products

The initial store will contain [X] existing products plus 3 new products.

We will supply product descriptions, images, prices, delivery charges and delivery-zone/postcode information.

Following training, we intend to upload approximately 10 further products ourselves, so the system needs to make adding and managing products straightforward.

This is an important part of the project.

We sell heavy bulk landscaping and aggregate products, so standard parcel shipping is not suitable. We currently intend to operate [X] delivery zones and will supply the relevant postcodes and delivery charges.

Customers should be able to enter their delivery postcode and receive the appropriate delivery charge.

Experience implementing postcode, distance or zonal delivery pricing within Wix would be beneficial.

SEO, Local SEO & AI Search

We want the site optimised for strong organic visibility through both conventional search engines and newer AI-powered search/answer platforms.

Scope should include:

Technical/on-page SEO
Local SEO targeting Andover, Hampshire and our delivery areas
Change the site name currently showing as “My Site” to “Rock Recycling”
Improve homepage SEO title and meta description
Review/tidy existing homepage copy and spelling
Optimise product/category pages
Keyword/search-intent optimisation
Internal linking, crawlability, sitemap and indexing
LocalBusiness and Product structured data/schema
Appropriate delivery-area/location pages
GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)
AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)
Structure content for visibility/discovery through AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Claude
Analytics/search performance tracking

We are not simply looking for an SEO app/plugin to be installed. Applicants should understand modern SEO, Local SEO and GEO/AEO and explain the work they propose to carry out.

Deliverables
Fully operational Wix e-commerce store
Initial products and delivery zones configured
Secure checkout/payment and VAT setup
Collection option
Mobile/desktop optimisation
SEO and Local SEO improvements
Product/category optimisation
LocalBusiness and Product schema where appropriate
Delivery-area pages
GEO/AEO optimisation
Analytics/tracking configuration
Full pre-launch testing
Basic training/documentation
Post-launch support for initial bugs/minor adjustments
When Applying

Please provide:

Examples of Wix e-commerce websites you have developed
Experience with postcode/zonal delivery pricing and how you would implement ours
Examples of SEO/Local SEO work
Details of genuine GEO/AEO or AI-search optimisation experience
What you would implement to improve our visibility through Google and AI-powered search
Your proposed approach
A fixed-price quotation, clearly stating what is and isn't included

We are looking for a professional and reliable developer, rather than simply the lowest-cost proposal.

£500–£1,500

title: Framer Portfolio Website Customization
proj_desc:
# Framer Website Customization Brief

I already have the **ReelHaus Framer template** and need an experienced Framer developer to customize it into my Motion Designer portfolio.

**Template:** [https://www.framer.com/marketplace/templates/reelhaus/](https://www.framer.com/marketplace/templates/reelhaus/)
**Main reference:** [https://lusion.co/](https://lusion.co/)

I’ve selected a few specific animations and interactions from Lusion that I want incorporated into my website. The requirements are below.

### 1. Animations and Interactions

- Animate text and icons on page load.
- The **PLAYREEL** section should slide in from the left toward the center while scrolling.
- Project cards and text should animate based on scroll direction, both down and up.
- Add subtle background music on page load, subject to browser autoplay restrictions.
- Recreate the selected animations from the Lusion reference. I’ll explain additional details during a call.

### 2. Final Navigation Layout

Place the navigation across the top, with **Work and About on the left**, and **Showreel and Let’s Talk on the right**.

- **Work, About, and Let’s Talk:** Smooth-scroll to their respective sections without changing the URL.
- **Showreel:** Smooth-scroll to the PLAYREEL section and change the URL to `/showreel`, without a `#` hash.
- Directly opening `/showreel` must load the website and automatically scroll to the Showreel section.

### 3. Design and CMS

- Strict black, white, and grey colour palette.
- CMS integration so I can easily manage and update projects.
- Videos must play directly on the website, with no YouTube redirects or external-page navigation.

### 4. Responsive Breakpoints — Mandatory

The existing ReelHaus template has only **3 breakpoints: Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile**.

You must **add one completely new breakpoint named Laptop**.

The final website must have **4 separate breakpoints: Desktop, Laptop, Tablet, and Mobile**. Do not simply adjust the existing three. I will verify that all four breakpoints exist and work correctly during handover.

### 5. Performance

Website speed and performance are non-negotiable. Keep animations smooth and avoid unnecessary elements or effects that slow down the website.

### 6. Handover Deliverables

Before completing the project, provide:

- The fully customized website in my existing Framer project.
- All four responsive breakpoints, properly designed and tested.
- Working navigation, animations, CMS, and on-site video playback.
- A functioning `/showreel` URL that also works when opened directly.
- Final testing across desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
- A brief handover confirming the work is complete and ready for me to review.

### Before Messgaing me;

Please review the ReelHaus template and Lusion reference, share relevant Framer projects you’ve built, and confirm that you can implement the requirements above, especially the **new Laptop breakpoint** and the navigation behaviour.

I’m looking for someone who can execute the brief properly within the agreed scope and budget.

West Drive Executive is a premium chauffeur and luxury vehicle business based in Birmingham, serving clients across the UK.

We are looking for a business development / partnerships specialist who can help us win high-value recurring clients and referral partners.

This is not a generic lead generation role and we are not interested in someone simply sending thousands of cold emails.

Our objective is to build relationships with organisations and individuals capable of generating significant recurring bookings.

Target Clients / Partners

We are particularly interested in developing relationships with:

Executive Assistants / Personal Assistants to HNW and UHNW individuals

Corporate travel managers

Family offices

Private aviation companies, FBOs and jet brokers

Luxury hotels and concierge teams

Luxury travel advisors and DMCs

Wealth management / private banking firms

Law firms, accountancy firms and professional services businesses

Event agencies

Celebrity / VIP management companies

Production companies

Luxury concierge businesses

Companies requiring executive transport for directors, clients and events

The goal is to win recurring corporate accounts, preferred-supplier relationships and referral partnerships, rather than one-off low-value bookings.

What We Need You To Do

Initially, we would expect you to:

Identify and research high-value target accounts.

Find the correct decision-makers within those organisations.

Build highly targeted prospect lists.

Develop outreach messaging tailored to each audience.

Carry out personalised outreach through email and/or LinkedIn.

Follow up professionally with prospects.

Generate qualified conversations and meetings.

Track prospects and opportunities in a simple CRM.

Help develop partnership propositions for hotels, aviation, concierge and corporate clients.

Work with us to turn initial bookings into recurring accounts.

We can personally handle important sales calls and meetings if necessary, so we are open to candidates who are particularly strong at identifying prospects and creating qualified opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

We are not interested in vanity metrics such as:

number of emails sent

email open rates

large unqualified lead lists

We care about:

conversations with genuine decision-makers

qualified meetings

trial bookings

corporate accounts opened

preferred-supplier relationships

recurring bookings

revenue generated from accounts you originate

Our longer-term aim is to develop relationships capable of generating £5,000–£20,000+ per month in chauffeur and executive transport revenue.

We understand that high-value relationships take time to develop and do not expect unrealistic overnight results.

Who We Are Looking For

We would particularly like to hear from people with experience in one or more of:

Luxury hospitality

Private aviation

Corporate travel

Executive transport

Luxury concierge

UHNW / private-client services

Family offices

Business development

B2B outbound sales

Strategic partnerships

Professional services

Events / VIP hospitality

Existing relationships within these industries would be a major advantage.

UK market experience is strongly preferred.

Budget / Working Arrangement

We are currently looking for a cost-effective freelancer rather than an expensive agency or £2,000+ per month consultant.

We are open to:

hourly arrangements

a small monthly commitment

project-based trials

base payment + performance commission

For the right candidate, we would be very happy to pay additional commission for genuinely valuable accounts that result in revenue.

We would prefer to begin with a small paid trial before committing long term.

When Applying

Please answer the following rather than sending a generic proposal:

1. Give one example of a high-value corporate or partnership client you personally helped win. What did you actually do?

2. Have you worked with luxury clients, executive assistants, corporate travel, private aviation, hotels, concierge businesses, family offices or similar audiences?

3. If you had 30 days to generate the first serious corporate opportunity for West Drive Executive, who would you target first and why?

4. How would you find and approach those decision-makers?

5. What would you personally do each week?

6. How would you measure your success?

7. Are you open to a small initial paid trial plus commission for accounts that generate revenue?

Please do not apply if your strategy is simply mass cold email or providing large generic lead lists.

We are looking for someone who understands that one excellent corporate or luxury relationship can be worth more than hundreds of ordinary enquiries.

title: Mobile App Developer (FlutterFlow + Supabase) - South Wales
proj_desc:
I am looking for an experienced mobile app developer to build a field lookup and grading tool from scratch for my catalytic converter recycling business, Crucible Exchange Ltd.

The app will be used on-site in the yard to quickly look up codes from a catalogue of ~14,500 items, factor in live PGM market movements, apply a custom margin fee structure, and calculate net buy prices on the spot.

Key Scope & Requirements:

Database & Scale (Supabase): Set up a PostgreSQL database handling ~14,500 catalog rows with image storage, optimized full-text search indexing across both primary and extra codes plus manufacturers, and proper Row Level Security (RLS).

Mobile Layout Architecture (FlutterFlow): Build a mobile-first ListView using custom Cards (Thumbnail Image, Primary Code, Extra Code, Manufacturer, Description) designed for fast, one-handed scanning on smartphones.

Search & Pagination: Implement server-side filtering and infinite-scroll pagination so 14.5k rows load instantaneously without lagging.

Pricing & Margin Engine: Integrate calculation logic that applies a percentage fee/margin structure against base PGM values or fixed pricing data.

Condition Grading Modifiers: Include quick-select buttons on the pricing view (Full Core - 100%, Partial/Damaged - %, Empty - 0%) that dynamically adjust the calculated buy price on the fly.

Batch Tally / Basket Feature: Allow users to tap "Add to Batch" on multiple converters to build a running total payout list for multi-unit purchases with an itemized summary output.

In-Person Kickoff: Must be based in or near South Wales (Cardiff, Newport, Swansea, Hengoed, or surrounding M4 area) for an initial in-person meeting to go over the physical dataset and valuation workflow. 
etc...

Deliverables:
Fully working mobile app built directly inside my existing FlutterFlow and Supabase accounts with 100% IP/source handover.

Budget:
Fixed Price: £1,000 (Split across 3 Escrow Milestones)

title: Migrate React Website, Booking Platform & Mobile Web App
proj_desc:
---Please provide a quote based on experience.---

We are looking for an experienced developer or small development company to migrate our existing Kapture website, booking platform and connected mobile web app to private hosting owned by our business.

Kapture provides property photography and media services. We have already developed the design and core workflows and can provide the source code, database schemas, branded assets and a detailed technical handover pack.

We want a cost-effective migration that preserves the existing design and functionality, with the necessary work to make the system reliable and maintainable.

The project covers:

- **Public website and CMS:** Move the website, editable content, galleries and uploaded files while preserving the current branding.
- **Booking platform:** Migrate bookings, clients, photographers, calendars, assignments, media delivery records and existing administrative functions.
- **Client and photographer app:** Preserve the connected mobile web experience on iPhone and Android, including bookings, daily schedules, shoot details, status updates and the existing live-location feature.
- **Login and permissions:** Replace the current hosting-dependent login with secure authentication and appropriate access for administrators, clients and photographers.
- **Email setup:** Configure and test existing transactional emails through Microsoft 365, including booking confirmations, shoot completion and media delivery. Preserve the current controls that keep client emails disabled during testing.
- **Push notifications:** Complete and test alerts for “photographer on the way”, “shoot complete” and photographer schedule confirmation. Admin marks a schedule complete, the photographer receives a notification and confirms it in the app.
- **Deployment and handover:** Set up staging and production environments, HTTPS, backups, monitoring, reliable background notification processing and clear maintenance instructions.

The existing code uses React, TypeScript, an Expo-based mobile app and Cloudflare-backed database and file storage. Please demonstrate relevant experience with application migrations, authentication, SQL, Microsoft Graph and browser push notifications.

The initial scope is the website, platform and browser-based app. Native App Store and Google Play releases, continuous background tracking and driving ETAs can be quoted separately.

Please include in your proposal:

1. Examples of similar migrations or booking systems you have delivered.
2. Who will carry out the work and their relevant experience.
3. Your proposed approach, estimated timeline and fixed-price milestones.
4. The cost of an initial technical review before confirming the full migration price.
5. Expected hosting costs and support after launch.

Hosting, source code and service accounts must remain under our ownership. We will provide the specification to suitable candidates and share the source pack with shortlisted developers.

proj_desc:
Social Media Manager & TikTok Content Creator Wanted – UK Training Company

Project Type: Freelance / Ongoing Work
Location: Remote – UK-Based Preferred
Budget: Open to competitive proposals

About Us

UK Training Services Ltd is a growing UK-based professional training provider specialising in First Aid, Mental Health First Aid, Pre-Hospital Care (FREC 3 & 4), Health & Safety, Safeguarding and other accredited training courses.

We are looking for an experienced, creative and results-driven Social Media Manager / Content Creator to develop our online presence, increase brand awareness and, most importantly, generate genuine customer enquiries and course bookings.

We want someone who understands how to market a professional training business, not simply someone who posts generic content.

What We Need

The successful freelancer will be responsible for:

Creating engaging TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, Facebook posts and LinkedIn content.

Producing professional short-form promotional videos using suitable footage, graphics, captions and voice-overs.

Developing a consistent social media strategy to promote our training courses.

Creating eye-catching, branded advertisements and promotional campaigns.

Increasing our social media following and engagement organically.

Driving relevant traffic to our website and converting interest into enquiries and bookings.

Planning and scheduling regular content across our social media platforms.

Researching relevant industry trends, hashtags and content opportunities.

Advising on paid advertising campaigns, including Facebook, Instagram and TikTok Ads.

Providing monthly performance reports showing reach, engagement, website traffic and leads.

TikTok & Video Content

TikTok and short-form video marketing will be a key part of this project.

We want professional, engaging videos that:

Promote our First Aid, Mental Health First Aid and FREC courses.

Explain the benefits of accredited training.

Target businesses, employers, training providers and individual learners.

Build trust and credibility in our training services.

Encourage viewers to visit our website and make bookings.

Content must be professional, accurate, original and appropriate for the UK training and healthcare education sector.

We do not want generic AI-generated videos, repetitive templates or low-quality automated content. AI-assisted tools may be used where appropriate, but the creative work must demonstrate genuine skill, originality and attention to our brand.

Essential Requirements

Applicants should have:

Proven experience managing business social media accounts.

Strong TikTok, Instagram Reels and Facebook video creation skills.

A portfolio of previous social media campaigns and video advertisements.

Excellent written English and an understanding of UK audiences.

Experience with professional video editing and graphic design.

Knowledge of social media algorithms, content strategy and audience targeting.

A commercial understanding of lead generation and customer conversion.

Experience marketing training providers, healthcare organisations, education companies or other professional services would be a significant advantage.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our social media marketing and deliver measurable improvements.

Our priority is quality enquiries, increased visibility and course bookings, rather than simply gaining followers.

We would initially consider a trial project, with the opportunity to establish a long-term working relationship based on performance.

How to Apply

When submitting your proposal, please include:

Examples of TikTok videos, Reels or social media campaigns you have personally created.

Details of businesses or brands you have previously managed.

Your proposed social media strategy for a UK training company.

Your suggested monthly content package, including the number of videos and posts.

Your fees for an initial trial project and ongoing monthly management.

Examples of measurable results you have achieved for previous clients.

Please do not send generic, copy-and-paste proposals. We want to see evidence that you understand our business and can explain how you would help us grow.

Company: UK Training Services Ltd
Website: www.uktrainingservices.co.uk

title: Embedded Systems Engineer (IoT adviser, contract)
proj_desc:
About us

We're a small climate technology company building solar-powered IoT monitoring devices that run off-grid in the field. Our design uses off-the-shelf components, and we write the device software in-house. We're looking for an experienced engineer to review our design and advise us, not to build it from scratch.*

We're also coming to Shenzhen to source components and have contacts there, the ideal candidate would also be able to help in finding the right suppliers.

What you'll do

- Review our hardware design and advise on components, connections and protocols
- Advise on low-power and solar/battery design, and on outdoor enclosures and connectors
- Review parts of our device code where your experience helps
- Recommend reliable suppliers in Shenzhen, and potentially join us for a few days during our sourcing trip
- Advise on samples, minimum order quantities, quality checks and export

Must have

- 5+ years in embedded systems or IoT, with devices you've shipped that run in the field
- Embedded Linux on single-board computers
- Industrial sensor interfaces and protocols (e.g. RS485/Modbus), Bluetooth Low Energy, cellular modems
- Low-power and solar/battery design
- Based in China, ideally in or near Shenzhen, with working contacts in the Shenzhen electronics supply chain
- Good written and spoken English

Nice to have

- Microcontroller firmware (e.g. ESP32)
- Outdoor, off-grid or agricultural deployments
- Experience with IP-rated enclosures and waterproof connectors

title: UK based social media all-rounder - group of launches
proj_desc:
Looking to launch a business in next week. Then a few others to follow in coffee, clothing and insurance! All requiring help with someone to generally manage but specifically ‘get them out there’ on social media platforms. Good bit of variety. 

First up is APPRaiSE, a property-tech tool built by a Glasgow developer with 30 years in the industry. Over the next month we're also launching products from coffee to insurance, with more to follow.

WHAT APPRAISE DOES
An in pocket project manager and assistant for those in the property industry. Drop in a project's drawings, cost plan, reports and emails, and it tells you what doesn't add up and what to ask your team, with the page every finding came from. You can even ask it by voice from your phone. It's for developers, consultants, lenders and agents, from £75 + VAT a month. [link]

WHAT YOU'LL DO (IT WILL FLEX AS WE GO)
- Turn my direction and raw material into LinkedIn posts, short phone videos and simple graphics, mostly posted from my profile
- Spot what's working, drop what isn't, and bring me ideas for what to try next
- Run small paid tests on LinkedIn and Meta (I fund the ads)
- Make small fixes and content updates on our websites, built on Lovable and Shopify: copy, images, links, SEO basics
- Help set up and launch each new brand as it comes on stream
- Send a short weekly note: what went out, what it did, what's next

YOU'LL SUIT THIS IF YOU
- Are UK-based and have grown B2B accounts on LinkedIn (property, construction or professional services is a bonus)
- Are happy switching between B2B and consumer brands
- Write plain, sharp UK English, and can make decent graphics and edit short vertical video
- Are comfortable in website builders (Lovable, Shopify, Webflow or similar) and know your SEO basics
- Like owning things and coming back with ideas, not just ticking off tasks

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
People trying APPRaiSE, not just likes: free trials, sign-ups, and a clear picture of which posts and channels bring them in.

HOW WE'LL START
A paid two-week trial, then an ongoing arrangement that grows as more brands launch. I'm open to a day rate, a retainer or a mix, so tell me what works for you.

TO APPLY (SHORT ANSWERS ARE FINE)
1. Show me one B2B post or campaign you're proud of, with the numbers.
2. Write a LinkedIn post (under 100 words) from this: "The cost plan priced 118 bedrooms. The schedule says 120. Nobody noticed for six weeks."
3. What would you do in your first two weeks?
4. Your rate, your availability, and which site builders you've worked in.

title: The Black Reserve Collectibles — Premium Brand Identity Design
proj_desc:
The Black Reserve Collectibles — Premium Brand Identity Design

Project Overview

I am seeking an experienced designer to develop the core brand identity for The Black Reserve Collectibles, an emerging premium trading-card and collectibles business initially focused on Pokémon cards, graded cards and sealed products.

This is a complete brand identity commission, not simply a logo design. The objective is to create a distinctive, professional and commercially practical identity that can grow with the business.

The work will be commissioned in separate phases, with Phase One being the only current commission.

Brand Vision and Creative Direction

The Black Reserve Collectibles should feel like a premium collector’s house: sophisticated, discreet, trustworthy and connected to collector culture.

The visual identity should be understated, luxurious and recognisable without looking like a generic gaming shop or esports brand.

Colour palette:

* Deep black.
* Ivory.
* Restrained burnt-orange or copper accents.

Required identity elements:

* Distinctive BR monogram.
* Primary wordmark: THE BLACK RESERVE COLLECTIBLES.
* Secondary or compact logo.
* Light and dark variations.
* Clean typography and consistent visual styling.

Avoid cartoon mascots, neon gaming aesthetics, generic templates, excessive gradients and unnecessary decorative elements.

The identity must be scalable, legible and suitable for digital and print applications.

Phase One — Core Brand Identity

Please quote for the following deliverables:

1. Primary logo and wordmark.
2. BR monogram.
3. Secondary logo variation.
4. Light, dark, full-colour and monochrome versions.
5. Brand colour palette with colour codes.
6. Typography recommendations.
7. Concise brand guidelines covering logo usage, colours and typography.
8. High-resolution transparent PNG files.
9. Editable vector files, including SVG and print-ready PDF.
10. Organised editable source files.
11. Confirmation of commercial usage rights, licensing and ownership.

Please specify the number of initial concepts, revision rounds, turnaround time and any additional charges.

The project should follow clear approval stages: initial concepts, selection of a preferred direction, refinement, final approval and file handover.

Phase One exclusions: Website development, social media templates, packaging artwork, product graphics, printing, photography and ongoing design support are not included unless separately agreed.

Phase Two — Digital and Retail Applications

Once Phase One is approved, potential future work may include:

* Social media graphics, banners and templates.
* Product listing and promotional graphics.
* Product photography layouts.
* Packaging stickers and labels.
* Thank-you cards, inserts and stationery.

Phase Two will have its own scope, quotation and timeline. There is no obligation to proceed.

Practical Requirements

The identity must work across e-commerce, online marketplaces, social media, product listings, packaging and future retail applications.

It should be practical to reproduce, easy to maintain and flexible enough to support additional collectible categories in the future.

I am looking for a designer with experience in premium branding, logo systems, monogram design, retail identity and digital applications. Original thinking, attention to detail and clear communication are important.

Budget and Quotation

My initial target budget is £100–£200 for Phase One, depending on the proposed scope and quality of work.

Please provide a fixed-price quotation specifying:

* Included deliverables and exclusions.
* Number of concepts and revisions.
* Timeline and approval process.
* Final file formats and editable source files.
* Commercial usage rights and ownership.
* Any additional licensing or third-party costs.

Indicative pricing for Phase Two is welcome but should be quoted separately.

How to Apply

Please include a portfolio link, examples of relevant branding projects, your proposed approach, fixed-price quotation, revision allowance and estimated timeline.

I am looking to establish a professional, distinctive and long-term brand identity, rather than purchase a disposable logo. I welcome proposals from designers who understand both premium brand development and practical commercial design.

title: System Engineer - US Timezone
proj_desc:
Core Responsibilities: 
* Support Linux servers, storage, enterprise infrastructure, and related environments both on-premises and in cloud.
 • Administer and troubleshoot network, storage, server, application, and system issues. 
* Support Axway MFT / Secure Transport and related on-premise and in-cloud environments. 
* Support secure, application-agnostic bulk file and data transfer solutions for structured, unstructured, and large-volume enterprise data exchanges across heterogeneous systems and external partners. 
* Assist with Symantec DLP and SPE-related activities. 
* Coordinate tasks with internal teams, customers, and third-party vendors; track work items and follow up to ensure completion. 
* Prepare technical documentation, procedures, runbooks, instructions, and support materials; train support staff and users as needed. 
* Support short-term and long-term planning, proactive issue prevention, market research, preliminary cost estimation, modernization, alternative solution assessment, and migration planning. 
* Provide continuity and technical support coverage when technical leadership is unavailable.
OS: 
* Experience in deploying, support and knowledge of Rocky Linux (8.9 and 9.x); and Windows OS 2022. 
* 5+ years experience with Linux administration and enterprise servers, networks, and systems. 
AWS Cloud Essential: 
* 3+ years experience in cloud environments and working knowledge with AWS services like EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Terraform, GitLab, ARM, AWF, ACM, EFS, S3, Transit Gateway. 
* Understanding of cloud networking (VCP, AZ, Security Groups, ALB, NLB). 
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation or AWS CDK.
* Exposure to AWS security best practices and hands-on experience with AWS CLI and Management Console.
* Amazon Relational Database Services, AWS Aurora PostgreSQL, AWS MySQL, and Amazon RDS on Oracle.
 Axway Secure Transport / MFT Fundamentals: 
* 5+ years experience with managed file transfer solutions, including enterprise bulk file/data transfer patterns supporting multiple business systems and external partners. 
* Understanding of secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, SSL). 
* Familiar with Axway ST set up, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration with authentication systems (LDAP, AD, OKTA, 2-Factor Auth). 
* Awareness of SSL/TLS encryption and certification management and familiarity with Axway Sentinel. 
* Experience supporting automated, secure, scalable, reliable, and high-volume enterprise transfer workflows is preferred. 
Cybersecurity / Access / Data Protection:
 • 5+ years knowledge of cybersecurity tools and practices. 
* Familiar with data encryption (Data in Use, Data at Rest, Data in Motion). 
* Authentication such as OKTA and Netskope remote access.
* Experience with Symantec DLP and SPE is preferred. 
Scripting / DevOps / Troubleshooting:
* Basic understanding of scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation. 
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git/Maintainer. 
* Basic troubleshooting skills for system and network issues.

title: Certified Hosting & Cybersecurity Partner Required
proj_desc:
Project type: B2B subcontracting / ongoing managed services  
Location: United Kingdom preferred  
Engagement: Initial implementation plus ongoing hosting, cybersecurity and support  
Client: Cashsend Ltd, UK software development company

Project overview

Cashsend Ltd is preparing a tender submission for the design, development, implementation and ongoing support of a public-sector airport website in the United Kingdom.

We intend to act as the prime contractor, delivering the website design, software development, integrations and project management.

We are seeking one established company to act as our specialist subcontractor, providing secure hosting, managed cybersecurity services, technical assurance and supporting compliance documentation.

Required services

- Secure, reliable cloud hosting for a public-facing website, including appropriate UK GDPR safeguards.
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified information security management, with certification scope covering the relevant services.
- Hosting infrastructure configuration, firewalls, encryption, access controls, monitoring and vulnerability management.
- Regular backups, disaster recovery arrangements and business continuity support.
- Security monitoring, incident detection, response and escalation.
- Penetration testing and vulnerability assessments, either directly or through qualified specialists.
- Technical assistance with a detailed Tier 1 Supplier Cybersecurity Questionnaire.
- Security policies, relevant supporting evidence, service-level agreements and documented responsibilities.
- Ongoing managed hosting, cybersecurity maintenance and technical support throughout the contract.

Mandatory supplier requirements

Applicants must:

1. Be an established, registered business, rather than an individual freelancer offering certification held by an unrelated organisation.
2. Hold valid ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a certificate and scope statement available for verification.
3. Demonstrate relevant experience hosting and securing commercial, government or other security-sensitive websites.
4. Be willing to be formally named as Cashsend Ltd's subcontractor in a UK public procurement submission.
5. Be able to provide a written subcontracting commitment and evidence for security due diligence.
6. Explain which security obligations their certification covers and which obligations would remain with Cashsend Ltd.
7. Be available for prompt discussions and preparation of a quotation.

Cyber Essentials Plus certification is highly desirable.

Please include in your response

- Company name, website and registration details.
- ISO 27001 certificate, certification body, scope and expiry date.
- Whether you hold Cyber Essentials Plus.
- Hosting infrastructure and proposed data-hosting locations.
- Relevant project experience.
- Availability for a rapid tender-stage review.
- Indicative implementation/setup cost.
- Annual hosting and cybersecurity management fees.
- Costs for penetration testing, disaster recovery and additional support.
- Confirmation that you are willing to participate as a declared subcontractor.

### Timing

This is time-sensitive. We are preparing a procurement submission with a reported deadline of **19 October 2026**.

We are seeking an initial response and indicative quotation as soon as possible.

Please respond only if your organisation can provide the necessary certification evidence and genuinely deliver the proposed services.

Cashsend Ltd

title: French Canadian voices for AI project - no experience needed
proj_desc:
I'm casting natural-sounding native Canadian French voices as part of a larger conversational AI project, and I'm specifically not looking for polished voiceover artists. I want people who sound like real people. The recording is in Canadian French and English.

Men and women are both welcome, of any adult age. Canadian French has to be your native language, spoken the way you actually speak it, not a learned or approximated accent. What matters is that you sound like a genuine person having a normal conversation. A bit of acting or improv is a bonus, but not required.

The session is remote, two hours at most: about 20 minutes of scripted lines plus natural, unscripted conversation, with a producer on the call.

THE PAY IS YEARLY AND ONGOING, NOT A ONE-OFF. The US$1,200 budget is an annual licence fee: you are paid US$1,200 every year the voice stays in use, for as long as it stays in use. On top of that there is a fixed US$200 session fee, paid after you record.

One requirement: you must have a decent microphone and a quiet, echo-free recording space. No voiceover experience needed, but clean audio is essential.

To apply, submit a proposal with a short, clear recording of yourself just talking naturally in Canadian French, attached or linked. No script needed: talk about your day, a hobby, anything. Please don't say your name in the recording.

This is AI voice work. Anyone selected signs a clear, non-exclusive annual licence that strictly prohibits deepfakes, impersonation or any unauthorised use. Your voice will never be used without your prior written consent.

title: Sales & Business Development Executive (Inbound & Outbound)
proj_desc:
Company: LeBern Ltd  
Location: Remote – UK business hours  
Engagement: Freelance, initially 4 weeks, with ongoing opportunities

About Us
LeBern is an established UK property services company supporting landlords, investors, letting agents and housing providers.

Our services include:

- Guaranteed Rent: Securing rental agreements and managing landlord relationships.
- Tenant Evictions: Helping landlords and agents navigate the legal possession process.
- Property Management: Managing residential properties on behalf of landlords.
- **Property Maintenance:** Providing maintenance and property support solutions.
- **Property Acquisition & Accommodation Supply:** Developing property opportunities and relationships with local authorities and housing providers.

We are looking to establish a dedicated, results-driven sales division to support business growth across all our services.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Sales & Business Development Executive capable of managing both inbound and outbound sales.

We currently have an existing customer database, regular inbound enquiries and established operational teams, but no dedicated sales team.

We need someone who can take ownership of sales opportunities, generate new business, convert enquiries into paying customers and help implement an organised, measurable sales process.

This is a revenue-generating sales position, not simply an appointment-setting or customer service role.

Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales
- Respond promptly to incoming enquiries from landlords, investors and agents.
- Qualify leads, understand customer needs and recommend appropriate services.
- Conduct sales consultations, handle objections and close deals.
- Follow up outstanding quotations, previous enquiries and prospective clients.
- Identify cross-selling opportunities across LeBern's services.

Outbound Business Development
- Proactively identify and contact landlords, investors, letting agents and property businesses.
- Conduct outbound calls, targeted email outreach and follow-ups.
- Re-engage existing and previous customers.
- Develop referral relationships and identify new commercial partnerships.
- Generate qualified leads, appointments and new business.

CRM & Sales Management
- Manage leads and opportunities through HubSpot CRM.
- Maintain accurate pipeline records and follow-up schedules.
- Help establish structured sales processes and communication templates.
- Coordinate with operational teams when onboarding new clients.
- Provide weekly reporting on activity, conversion rates, pipeline value and revenue generated.

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 3 years' proven sales or business development experience.
- Strong track record of closing deals and generating revenue.
- Experience managing both inbound and outbound sales.
- Excellent telephone communication, negotiation and objection-handling skills.
- Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM systems.
- Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working independently.
- Excellent written and spoken English.
- Availability during UK business hours.

Highly Desirable:
- UK property, estate agency, lettings or landlord services experience.
- Experience selling legal, financial or professional services.
- Previous involvement in establishing sales processes or teams.

Initial Project & Expectations

We propose an initial paid four-week trial, approximately 40–60 hours, with the potential for an ongoing engagement.

Key objectives:

1. Manage and convert existing inbound enquiries.
2. Reactivate previous leads and customer relationships.
3. Generate qualified new business through outbound prospecting.
4. Maintain an accurate, organised sales pipeline.
5. Demonstrate measurable sales activity, conversion and revenue results.
6. Help establish the foundations of an efficient, scalable sales operation.

Performance will be assessed against agreed sales KPIs, including qualified opportunities, proposals, conversion rates and completed business.

All sales activity must follow our approved commercial processes and applicable UK marketing and data protection requirements.

Fees & Incentives

Please quote your hourly rate or fixed project fee for the initial engagement.

We are open to a competitive base fee plus performance-related incentives linked to genuine commercial results.

 How to Apply

Please provide:

1. A summary of your relevant sales experience.
2. Examples of previous sales results, including revenue generated or conversion rates.
3. Your experience selling UK property or related services.
4. Your approach to managing inbound enquiries and outbound prospecting.
5. Your experience with HubSpot CRM.
6. Your proposed rate and weekly availability.

We are looking for a commercially driven sales professional who can take ownership, generate revenue and grow with the business.

Successful candidates may be invited to an initial interview to discuss their experience and approach.

Our brand combines gothic romance, individuality and functional riding apparel, creating something different for riders who don't identify with traditional equestrian fashion.

Our philosophy: BORN TO RIDE DIFFERENT.

I'm looking to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who genuinely enjoys supporting entrepreneurs, takes initiative, thinks commercially and can manage agreed responsibilities independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT

- Minimum one daily update on each of TikTok, Instagram and Facebook, including weekends.
- Plan, prepare, repurpose and schedule content in advance wherever possible.
- Create engaging captions, branded Canva graphics and simple short-form video edits.
- Maintain a content calendar and help grow an engaged pre-launch community.
- Monitor basic engagement and report on performance.
- Work with founder-supplied photographs, videos, ideas and brand direction.

2. EXECUTIVE ASSISTANCE & BUSINESS ORGANISATION

- Manage business diary, meetings, appointments and reminders.
- Maintain a central tracker of deadlines, priorities and outstanding tasks.
- Organise business emails, correspondence and documents.
- Follow up with designers, consultants, suppliers and other business contacts.
- Help coordinate ongoing projects and launch preparations.
- Provide a concise weekly progress report.

3. RESEARCH & BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES

- Proactively identify relevant grants, funding programmes, business awards, competitions, networking events and trade shows.
- Research potential suppliers, partnerships, influencers and collaborations.

title: Creative Video Producer Required – Premium Lifestyle Brand
proj_desc:
We are seeking a talented and creative video producer/content creator to develop a high-quality lifestyle marketing video for an established UK home and lifestyle ecommerce brand.

The video will primarily be used across our social media marketing channels (Facebook and Instagram), with potential use on our website and in paid advertising campaigns.


The Objective

We want to create a visually striking, engaging lifestyle video that captures attention within the first few seconds and showcases our product in a way that inspires, engages and ultimately encourages customers to explore further.

This shouldn't feel like a traditional product advert. We're looking for something more aspirational and lifestyle-led, demonstrating how the product complements modern living and enhances everyday experiences.


Creative Direction

Our brand has a contemporary, minimalist aesthetic, with an emphasis on modern interiors, clean design and understated sophistication.

The video must:
•	Capture attention immediately, particularly when viewed within busy social media feeds.
•	Present the product naturally within an aspirational, contemporary home environment.
•	Tell a compelling visual story, focusing on lifestyle, convenience and everyday benefits rather than simply listing product features.
•	Feel premium, authentic and professionally produced.
•	Follow our established brand guidelines, including visual identity, colours, typography, tone of voice and overall styling.
•	Balance creative storytelling with commercial effectiveness, encouraging engagement and driving interest in the product.
•	Avoid overly aggressive sales messaging, gimmicky effects or generic advertising styles.

We are open to creative ideas and would particularly welcome someone who can bring fresh concepts and suggestions rather than simply working from a prescribed script.


Project Requirements

We envisage a main video of approximately 20–30 seconds, although we welcome recommendations on the ideal length and format.

Ideally, we would also like to explore shorter edits suitable for paid social advertising, along with versions optimised for different placements:
•	Vertical (9:16) – Instagram/Facebook Reels and Stories
•	Square (1:1) or portrait (4:5) – Social media feeds
•	Landscape (16:9) – Potential website use

We would like the selected creative to manage the concept, storyboard, production and post-production, including appropriate music, sound design, editing and any graphics or text overlays.

We are open to different production approaches, including live-action filming, professional CGI or high-quality AI-assisted production, provided the final result is realistic, visually consistent and appropriate for a premium brand.


What We're Looking For

Ideally, you will have experience producing engaging video content for lifestyle, interiors, home improvement or premium consumer brands.

Please provide:
1.	Examples of relevant videos you have previously created.
2.	A brief explanation of your creative approach and how you would tackle this project.
3.	Details of your production process, including whether you use live filming, CGI, AI or a combination.
4.	An indication of the deliverables included in your quotation, along with any additional costs.
5.	Your estimated turnaround time and number of revisions included.
6.	Confirmation that the finished content can be used commercially across our website, social media and paid advertising, with appropriate usage rights for all included assets.


Additional Information

Further details about our brand, product, existing creative assets and brand guidelines will be shared privately with shortlisted applicants.

We are looking for someone who understands that great lifestyle marketing is about more than showing a product — it's about creating a visual experience that resonates with the right audience.

There is also potential for ongoing creative work if this initial project is successful.

We look forward to reviewing your ideas and previous work.

title: UK solicitor to check a privacy policy, terms and cookie notice
proj_desc:

It helps them keep their own records about their children: incidents, school and social care letters, appointments, and what to do if a child goes missing. It is run by a UK Ltd small company in UK. A UK-qualified solicitor, regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA), to review three documents we have already drafted in plain English:

- Privacy policy (16 pages)
- Terms of use (6 pages)
- Cookie notice (3 pages)

About 24 points are already marked with yellow "Solicitor to check" tags, so you can see exactly where we need your view. 

The main areas are:

- UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018: the lawful basis for special category data about children and other people that parents record (Article 9(2)(a) and Schedule 1 paragraphs 18 and 29), and whether we need an appropriate policy document.

- International transfers for our service providers 

- Retention periods, and how we answer data requests.

- Consumer law for a monthly or yearly subscription: the 14-day cancellation right for digital services, renewal wording, notice periods, limitation of liability, and VAT wording.

- UK-only eligibility, governing law, and Scottish and Northern Irish consumers.

- PECR: our cookie notice, and our email marketing consent.

- A short check that our warning about family court documents is right for England and Wales.

What we'd like back

- Tracked changes or comments on the three documents.

- A short list of anything we must fix before launch, kept separate from things that are nice to have.

- A short draft of the appropriate policy document, if you think we need one. Please quote for this separately.

- Please include in your proposal

- Your SRA number, or your firm's name, and confirmation that you hold professional indemnity insurance.

- A fixed price for the review, and how quickly you can turn it around.

Any experience with apps, UK GDPR, or children's or sensitive data.

title: Honest 5-minute DictaFlow video review: face + screen demo
proj_desc:
We make DictaFlow, a voice-typing app, and want ONE creator to download it, genuinely try it in everyday tasks, and record an honest English-language video review.

Fixed budget: US$10 total for one finished video. This is a small paid test. Payment is for your work, not for a positive opinion. Explain what works, what does not, and who the app suits.

DELIVERABLE
- At least 5 minutes long (aim for 5–7 minutes), landscape 16:9, preferably 1080p.
- Your real face must appear: an on-camera introduction plus a webcam overlay during demonstrations. No faceless video, AI avatars or synthetic narration.
- Readable screen recordings showing actual DictaFlow use, with clear English narration. Keep your webcam away from important controls and text.
- Demonstrate at least two everyday uses, such as writing an email, taking notes or drafting a document. Use safe example text; do not expose private information.
- Give your own balanced assessment based on real use. Include a clear disclosure that DictaFlow paid for the review and opinions are your own.
- Deliver the finished video file through PeoplePerHour. No posting to your own social accounts and no follower minimum.
- One reasonable revision for missing requirements or technical problems; we will not request changes to an honest opinion.

TO APPLY
1. Link an EXISTING short video of yourself speaking English on camera. A 30–60-second section of a longer portfolio video is fine; include a timestamp. We assess understandable speech, natural delivery and audio quality, not a particular accent.
2. Tell us your device and operating system.
3. Suggest two everyday tasks where you would genuinely use voice typing.
4. State your expected delivery time after hiring.

Do not create a new audition or record a DictaFlow review to apply. We will review applications and select one person before paid work starts.

The price includes 90 days of nonexclusive use of the delivered review on DictaFlow's website and organic social accounts, with no misleading edits. Paid ads and whitelisting are excluded. You retain portfolio use. We will confirm scope and suitable product access before recording; do not buy a subscription to apply.

title: Video Editor for Horror & Mystery YouTube Channel
proj_desc:
Horror / Mystery YouTube Video Editor

I run a growing YouTube channel focused on disturbing stories, internet mysteries, rabbit holes, unexplained events, and unsettling corners of the internet.

The style is inspired by creators like Nexpo, Nick Crowley, Farrell McGuire, Lazy Masquerade, and ScareTheater. I’m looking for an editor who can create atmospheric, high-quality, immersive videos in this niche.

What I Need

I will handle the story research and final narration myself.

Once I have the story and record the narration, I will send everything to you. Your job will be to turn it into a complete, polished YouTube video.

This includes:

Finding suitable b-roll, images, videos, screenshots, and other visual assets
Generating assets with AI when appropriate
Creating or sourcing visuals that fit the story and atmosphere
Editing the narration and visuals together
Adding subtle motion, effects, transitions, text, and visual layering
Using appropriate background music and sound effects
Creating a dark, cinematic, unsettling atmosphere
Maintaining good pacing and visual variety without over-editing

I’m looking for story-driven editing, where the visuals support the narration rather than distract from it.

The final result should feel polished, immersive, and professional.

Editing Style

I’m not looking for flashy editing or constant effects.

I want something atmospheric, cinematic, mysterious, and occasionally unsettling. Think of the visual storytelling and pacing used by channels such as Nexpo, Nick Crowley, Farrell McGuire, Lazy Masquerade, and ScareTheater, while still allowing you to develop your own style.

You can use any editing software you prefer. The important thing is the final result, not the program you use.

You should have access to a capable laptop or computer suitable for video editing.

AI Use

I have no problem with AI being used as part of your workflow, including for generating visuals, provided it is used creatively and appropriately.

AI should be a tool to improve the production, not a replacement for creativity and editing skills.

Compensation & Long-Term Opportunity

The channel is currently not monetized, and I’m funding the project myself.

For now, the payment is $10 per completed video.

My goal is to monetize the channel and turn this into a permanent position. Once the channel starts generating revenue, I intend to increase the compensation accordingly.

I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the channel rather than someone interested in a one-off project.

If you enjoy creating dark, atmospheric videos and want to grow alongside a YouTube channel from its early stages, I’d love to hear from you.

More details about the workflow and collaboration can be discussed privately or on a call.

title: Canva / Adobe Designer – 100-Page Guide with AI Images
proj_desc:
Experienced Canva / Adobe Designer Needed –70 (rough estimate)-Page Digital Activity Guide with AI Images

I am the founder of The Early Years Advisory, a Dubai-based early childhood education consultancy, and I am looking for an experienced graphic designer to create a professional, premium-quality digital activity guide for parents of young children.

The guide will be approximately 100 pages, featuring a collection of practical, engaging activities that parents can enjoy with their children at home.

What I Already Have

A significant amount of the preparation has already been completed:

- Written content: All activities have been drafted in Microsoft Word. The designer will not need to write the activities, but will need to transfer and format the content into the publication.
- Established branding: I have my company logo, brand colours and fonts, which must be used throughout the guide.
- Existing branded materials: I can share examples of other professionally branded documents and marketing materials from my company to provide a clear understanding of the style and visual identity I would like to maintain.

What I Need

1. Professional Digital Guide Design

- Design and format approximately 100 pages using Canva, Adobe InDesign or another suitable professional design platform.
- Transfer my existing activity content from Microsoft Word into the designed publication.
- Create a consistent, attractive layout for each activity.
- Incorporate my existing brand colours, fonts and logo.
- Design a professional front cover, contents page and any necessary introductory or supporting pages.
- Ensure the final guide is visually appealing, easy to read and suitable for sale as a premium digital product.

2. AI-Generated Activity Images

Each activity will need an accompanying AI-generated image that visually demonstrates or represents the activity.

This will involve creating up to 100 individual AI images.

The images should be:

- Realistic, natural and high quality.
- Appropriate for an early childhood and parenting publication.
- Consistent in style, lighting and overall appearance.
- Accurate representations of the activities described.
- Suitable for commercial use.

I would prefer realistic photographic-style imagery rather than cartoons or illustrations.

### 3. Final Deliverables

- A complete, professionally designed digital guide of approximately 100 pages.
- A high-resolution PDF suitable for digital sale and distribution.
- A fully editable Canva or Adobe source document so that I can make future changes.
- All AI-generated images used in the guide.
- Full commercial usage rights for the final designs and images.

### Design Style

I am looking for something that feels premium, modern, warm, natural and professional.

Although the guide is focused on activities for young children, the intended audience is parents. I do not want the design to feel overly childish, cluttered or like a traditional school worksheet.

The finished publication should feel like a beautifully designed, professionally published activity book.

Ideal Freelancer

I am looking for someone who:

- Has strong experience with Canva, Adobe InDesign or professional publication design.
- Can demonstrate previous experience designing eBooks, digital guides, workbooks or similar publications.
- Has experience generating realistic AI images.
- Has excellent attention to detail and consistency.
- Can follow an established brand identity.
- Can manage the complete project from initial design through to final delivery.

Budget and Timeline

I am open to receiving proposals and would like freelancers to provide an estimated fixed price for the complete project, including design, AI image generation and revisions.

Please also provide your estimated turnaround time.

Before committing to the full project, I would like to arrange a paid sample of 2–3 activity pages, including AI-generated images, to ensure the design style and quality are aligned with my expectations.

When Applying, Please Include

1. Examples of similar digital publications you have designed.
2. Examples of realistic AI-generated images you have created.
3. Your preferred design software.
4. Your estimated fixed price for the complete project.
5. Your estimated turnaround time.
6. The number of revisions included in your quote.

I am looking for a talented, reliable designer who can bring this project to life to a very high standard. There is also potential for further digital guide projects in the future.

I’m the founder of PrediabetesBasket.com, a UK subscription web app for people who have been told they are prediabetic.

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Two relevant examples of subscription businesses, web apps or consumer services you have helped grow.
2. What you personally did, the starting position, campaign budget, timeframe and measurable results.
3. Evidence supporting those results, such as anonymised reports, case studies or a client reference.
4. Your initial observations about PrediabetesBasket.com and what you would investigate first.
5. Your fixed price for the initial review and plan, plus a separate implementation quote and proposed advertising budget.
6. Confirmation of which work you will personally carry out and anything you would outsource.

Experience reaching UK consumers and working with small budgets is particularly relevant. Health-related experience would be helpful; our service provides educational feedback and marketing must avoid unsupported medical claims.

I’m looking for clear reasoning, relevant evidence and practical delivery. Please explain how you would test your approach and decide whether to continue, change or stop a campaign.

title: Business Development Manager - Hourly Rate and Commission
proj_desc:
Sector: Residential Property / Residential Surveying
Pay: Hourly rate + commission for each new referrer successfully converted

About the Role

My company is looking for a proactive, commercially minded and results-driven Business Development & Partnerships Manager to develop new referral relationships with estate agents, solicitors and other relevant residential property professionals.

The objective is simple: identify suitable referral partners, build genuine relationships and convert them into regular sources of survey referrals.

A good working knowledge of the UK residential property market is required. Ideally, you will have direct experience in residential surveying or valuation, although we will also consider candidates from related backgrounds such as estate agency, conveyancing, property consultancy, mortgage/property services or residential sales.

You will initially work closely with a Director to understand our services, USPs, referral proposition and approach. This may involve shadowing calls and emails, us observing your initial calls, and a small number of online meetings.

Once familiar with the process, you will be expected to take ownership of it.

The Role

This is not a role where success is measured simply by calls or emails sent. We want someone who takes initiative and is focused on creating genuine, revenue-generating referral relationships.

You will be expected to:

Proactively identify new estate agent, solicitor and property-sector opportunities.

Research suitable firms using Rightmove, Google, company websites and other sources.

Identify the correct decision-maker for surveyor recommendations or referral relationships.

Make contact by telephone and email.

Build rapport and understand existing referral arrangements.

Establish whether they recommend surveyors and are open to additional partners.

Explain the benefits of working with Lexington Surveyors.

Discuss referral commission where appropriate.

Follow up consistently and develop relationships over time.

Keep accurate records of interactions, follow-ups and next actions.

Convert suitable prospects into active referrers.

Some opportunities will be provided, particularly where we have recently surveyed a property being marketed by a particular estate agent. However, an important part of the role is generating your own opportunities rather than waiting for leads to be supplied.

Our Proposition

You will learn how to communicate the benefits of Lexington Surveyors, including our residential surveying and valuation services, strong communication, professional service, report turnaround times, referral arrangements and understanding of the importance of helping property transactions progress successfully.

The aim is not necessarily to convert someone on the first call. You will follow up by telephone and email and remain in appropriate contact until the opportunity converts or is no longer worth pursuing.

Where necessary, a very warm and well-qualified opportunity can be passed to a Director for the final conversation. Early-stage leads should not simply be passed back internally.

Initiative & Ownership

We are specifically looking for someone who does not need every task handed to them. You will build and manage your own pipeline and increase activity as your understanding of the business develops.

The role may start relatively slowly while we establish the process and ensure the quality of interactions is right. Once established, we expect you to work increasingly independently and drive the process forward. You will have a weekly meeting with a Director to review activity, pipeline, results and priorities.

Pay & Commission

The role will be paid at an agreed hourly rate, together with a healthy performance-based commission. You will receive a minimum £100 commission for each first-time survey instruction we complete directly as a result of a new referrer you have personally identified, developed and converted. This is designed to directly reward initiative and measurable results.

The Ideal Person

We are looking for someone who is proactive, results driven, commercially minded, confident on the telephone, a strong written communicator, naturally good at building rapport, organised, persistent without being overly pushy and comfortable working independently.

Relevant experience is desirable.

How to Apply

When applying, please make it clear any relevant UK residential property experience you have. Please highlight any experience in residential surveying or valuation, estate agency, conveyancing, residential sales, working with surveyors or other property professionals, and business development within the property industry.

We are less interested in generic sales experience alone and more interested in someone who understands residential property, can communicate credibly with estate agents, solicitors and other professionals, and has the initiative to turn opportunities into genuine commercial relationships.

We are happy to adapt the final workflow around the successful applicant if they already have a proven and efficient way of working.
What matters to us
We are more interested in quality and ownership of the process than simply volume.
We want somebody who can research intelligently, communicate credibly with UK business decision-makers, keep accurate records, follow prospects up when promised and identify genuine opportunities rather than simply report activity.
Trust, reliability and the ability to work independently are extremely important to us.
Previous experience in commercial energy would be useful but is not essential. Experience with UK B2B sales, professional services, telecoms, finance, SaaS or other consultative B2B markets would also be relevant.

7. How you propose to host the integration and securely handle customer data.

title: iOS developer:  app from detailed spec and existing Swift source
proj_desc:
Skippers Online is a UK online sailing school. Our lessons app, "Skippers Lessons", is finished and working on Android and Windows. We now need an experienced iOS developer to bring the iPhone/iPad version to the App Store.

The code is already written. The Swift source for the iOS app has been written with Claude (Anthropic's AI) from a detailed technical handover, but it has not yet been compiled or run, because it was written without a Mac. Your job is to turn it into a working, published app.

What the app does:
- Students sign in with their Skippers Online account (or continue as a guest)
- They download narrated HTML5 lessons (roughly 100-200 MB each) and play them offline
- Access to each course is controlled by the server; lessons can be deleted to free space
- Password reset happens inside the app

What you'll receive:
- The Swift source files (WKWebView, background URLSession downloads, Keychain, ZIPFoundation), iOS 17+, universal iPhone and iPad
- The shared lesson-list screen (one HTML page, used unchanged by all our apps)
- A 25-page handover document covering the design, the server calls and a full test checklist
- The working Android app and source code for reference
- The server side is complete and live: you won't need to change it

Your job:
- Set up the Xcode project from the supplied code and get it building
- Fix whatever doesn't compile or doesn't behave correctly on a real iPhone and iPad
- Test against the checklist (sign-in, guests, downloads in the background, offline playback, audio with the silent switch on, and so on)
- Set up TestFlight, then take the app through App Store review to release, under our own Apple Developer account (you'll be added as a team member)

Requirements:
- Proven apps in the App Store; please include links
- Experience with WKWebView, background downloads and App Store submission
- Willing to work with existing code rather than rewrite it
- UK-based or able to work UK hours is a plus

How we'll maintain it: we intend to keep maintaining the app with Claude after handover, including Apple's yearly rebuild. So please keep it simple to pick up: plain Swift with as few third-party libraries as possible, clear comments, a README covering setup, build and release, and a build that runs from the command line (xcodebuild) as well as in Xcode. You're welcome to use AI tools such as Claude Code yourself.

At the end we must receive the full Xcode project and source code; we own all rights to the work.

In your proposal, please give:
1. A fixed price for getting the supplied code working and released, with your estimated timescale
2. A price for the yearly update Apple requires (rebuilding with the current Xcode and resubmitting), as a fallback
3. Links to two or three apps you've built

Shortlisted applicants will receive the code and the full handover pack.

title: Editor and designer for a fun, relatable YouTube card channel
proj_desc:
Hi! We're a husband-and-wife YouTube channel doing trading card pack openings and pack battles (Pokémon, football and wrestling cards).

We've only just started, with 4 videos so far, so we're open to changing everything: logo, fonts, colours, the lot. We're time-poor and don't have the hours to edit or learn new software. We tried making our own videos and graphics with AI tools, and the feedback on Reddit was that it looked like AI slop. That's the one thing we really want to avoid.

We're not against AI being used as a tool somewhere in your process, but the finished work must look distinctive, human-made and recognisably ours. If it looks like the generic AI style you see all over YouTube and Whatnot, it's not what we're after.

We want the channel to feel relatable and warm, like viewers are hanging out with us. We're no experts, and we know some of the videos won't be perfect, so we're not expecting you to work miracles; we just want the videos to have a basic edit so they flow well, there's some sort of graphics here and there, maybe some prices, or the odd GIF.  I'll provide you with any pricing or information so you don't need to spend time on this. 

PLEASE QUOTE SEPARATELY FOR EACH OF THESE

1. Graphics package (one-off price)

Brand refresh - Logo, colour palette, font choices and a simple style guide. We're open to your ideas, so please show us your thinking.
Reusable graphics - Channel banner, editable thumbnail template, animated intro and outro, end screen and lower thirds, all in the new style. We're thinking it might be best to just use an image of us both for the thumbnail to make it more real. 
Files - Please confirm we receive the editable source files and full ownership. I want to be able to use these as I please. 

2. Video editing (price per video)

We'll have some videos, ranging from 5 minutes to 25-30 minutes each. Please give us two prices:

Edit only - One finished long-form video, with pacing, music, captions and a bit of fun on the big pulls.
Edit plus Shorts - The same video, plus Shorts cut from it. Please say how many Shorts are included, for example, 3.

3. Shorts (price per clip)

Standalone Shorts - If you'd also edit Shorts that don't come from a long video, please quote that too.

WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR PROPOSAL

Examples - Two or three pieces of your work. Any niche is fine. We're looking at your design taste, pacing and sense of humour.
Process note - How you work, and whether you use AI at any stage. As I said, I'm not anti AI, it's the outcome that matters. But if you're just going to use ChatGPT, please do not apply, I've tried this myself and this is the sort of outcome that doesn't resonate. 
Turnaround - How long you'd need per long video and per Short.
Revisions - How many rounds are included in each quote.
What's included - Please confirm whether each price covers music, captions and sound clean-up, so quotes are easy to compare.
Ongoing work - Whether you'd be available regularly if we get on well.

Don't use the budget shown as a guide. Please quote each item separately as listed above. This is vital to understand where we'd be in terms of ongoing orders.

title: WordPress Elementor + GeoDirectory Expert Needed
proj_desc:
We have recently launched a major rebuild of I Love Manchester, a busy city media and What's On website, and are looking for an experienced WordPress developer with strong Elementor Pro and GeoDirectory experience to help us iron out some post-launch issues and generally improve the look, feel and user experience.

The site is already live and functioning. We need someone who understands the existing setup, can identify what is causing particular behaviours and make sensible improvements without creating unnecessary custom code or breaking other parts of the site.

The current stack includes:
- WordPress
- Elementor Pro
- GeoDirectory for Places/business listings
- GeoDirectory Events for What's On/event listings
- GeoDirectory Location Manager / location functionality
- WooCommerce
- MemberPress
- Yoast SEO
- Advanced Ads
- Cloudflare
- Imagify

The overall idea is that each specialist plugin does what it is good at, with Elementor handling the presentation and templates, rather than trying to force everything through one theme.

Some of the issues we currently need looking at:

GeoDirectory / Places
- Places currently only seem to appear on the relevant area or neighbourhood page when the location is manually tagged. We would expect the physical address/location data to drive this wherever possible.
- Review the way Place category archives work. For example, Cafes & Coffee Shops currently sends users into GeoDirectory URLs such as /places/category/cafes-coffee/greater-manchester/manchester/. We want to make sure the structure and UX make sense.
- A user has reported problems trying to submit/add a listing, so the complete front-end submission journey needs testing.
- Review Places search and filters generally and suggest improvements.
GeoDirectory Events / What's On
- Existing formatting issue involving commas on event listings.
- "Load More" isn't working on some Event search/archive results.
- Event date display needs improving. It currently tends to show either "From [date]" or "Until [date]". For events with a defined run, we would like the start and end dates to be much clearer.
- Some listings can give the impression that an event starts on a particular date and then continues indefinitely. We need sensible handling of end dates and recurring events.
- Review event ordering, recurrence and archive/search behaviour generally.
Search / UX
- Our Explore search currently allows a user to select the type of venue in the first field, but selecting it can immediately trigger the search before they have had the chance to enter the area/location in the second field.
- We want the overall Places and Events search experience to feel intuitive, particularly on mobile.
- We'd welcome recommendations on anything else you notice that adds unnecessary friction.

Performance
We would also like somebody to review the implementation from a performance perspective, including:
- Elementor output
- GeoDirectory queries and widgets
- Image sizing and optimisation
- JPG/WebP/appropriate image formats rather than unnecessarily large PNG photographs
- Imagify
- Lazy loading
- Caching
- Cloudflare configuration
- Compression
- Static asset caching
- Any obvious front-end bloat

We are not expecting somebody to promise an arbitrary PageSpeed score. We want an experienced developer who can identify where the genuine bottlenecks are and make sensible improvements.

How we would like to work

The website is live and commercially important, so we need somebody methodical.

Initially, we'd like somebody to audit the issues above, tell us what is straightforward, what requires development and what may simply be configuration, then agree priorities and cost before proceeding.

We're looking for somebody we can potentially build an ongoing relationship with, so good communication is just as important as technical ability.

When applying

Please include:
- Specific examples of sites you've built or worked on using GeoDirectory and Elementor Pro.
- Your experience with GeoDirectory Events, Location Manager and Advanced Search if applicable.
- How you would approach diagnosing the issues above.
- Your availability.
- Whether you prefer hourly or fixed-price work.
- An initial estimate for reviewing the site and producing a prioritised list of fixes.

Please don't send a generic WordPress proposal. GeoDirectory experience is important for this project.
